create_image_generation: create a Bedrock image generation request and return the generated image URL synchronously
run_async_image_generation: run an async Bedrock image generation request and return the generated image URL
build_request_body_bedrock: build the request body dict for a Bedrock image generation call from a text prompt and optional params
transform_response_to_openai: transform a Bedrock image generation response dict into an OpenAI-compatible ImageResponse object
prepare_bedrock_request: prepare a full Bedrock image generation request with URL, headers, and body from model and prompt
